dish: Classical French cuisine at the counter

w: Michelin Bib Gourmand ramen shop whose signature soy-sauce ramen rests on a chicken broth of guinea fowl and free-range chicken raised together by a like-minded farmer.

dish: Japanese seasonal course

dish: Counter-and-grill kappo course

dish: Chinese cuisine
